questions.q: What does the pipeline runs list view show by default?
options: Every triggered pipeline run in the selected time window
Only pipeline runs that have failed
Only pipelines that are currently running
A list of every dataset in the data factory
questions.explain: The default Monitor view lists triggered pipeline runs for the selected time range, filterable by status, pipeline name, or annotation.

questions.q: How do you see which specific activity inside a pipeline caused a failure?
options: Click the pipeline name to drill into its activity runs list
The pipeline runs list already shows which activity failed
Activity-level detail isn't available in the Monitor hub
You must check the Azure Activity Log instead
questions.explain: Clicking a pipeline run's name opens the activity runs view, showing every activity in that run individually, including which one actually failed.

questions.q: What does an activity error's "failure type" field tell you?
options: Whether the failure is something like a user configuration issue versus another category
The exact line number in the pipeline JSON that caused the error
How many times the activity has failed historically
Nothing useful — only the raw exception text matters
questions.explain: The failure type classifies the error (for example, "User configuration issue"), which is often the fastest way to know where to start looking before reading the full exception text.

questions.q: When is the Gantt view more useful than the list view?
options: When you want to spot patterns in a pipeline's run history over time
When you need the exact error message for one failed activity
The Gantt view replaces the list view entirely and has no distinct use
Only when monitoring trigger runs, never pipeline runs
questions.explain: The Gantt view lays out runs as bars over a time range, one row per pipeline — ideal for noticing a pipeline that's suddenly running much longer than usual.

questions.q: What's the real difference between "Rerun" and "Rerun from failed activity"?
options: Rerun restarts the whole pipeline; rerun from failed activity skips activities that already succeeded
They do exactly the same thing, just from different screens
Rerun from failed activity is only available for Copy activities
Rerun creates a new pipeline; rerun from failed activity edits the existing one
questions.explain: Rerun from failed activity avoids redoing work that already completed successfully, restarting only from the activity that actually failed.
